name: Chibi Pire! ~Kyuuketsu Shimai to Ecchi de Bitch na Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: ちびパイア！ ～吸血姉妹とエッチでビッチな同棲性活～
source:
Yuusuke is an ordinary convenience store clerk. Ordinary except that he's a huge lolicon. After work he finds Lily, a little girl with wings on her back passed out in the alley behind his work. She hits all of his strike zones, a perfect loli body. Fearful yet not willing to pass up the chance he picks her up and rushes home.

Seeing her on his bed he can't control himself against such a perfect little girl and he rapes her. But she enjoys it! Even more her younger sister Lycoris comes searching for her sister Lily. Soon, he has sex with them both!
translation:
優介是個普通的便利商店店員，唯一與眾不同的地方，就是他是個重度蘿莉控。下班後，他在店後巷發現一個背後長著翅膀、昏倒的小女孩。她完美符合他的偏好，擁有無可挑剔的蘿莉身材。他既害怕又不願錯過機會，於是抱起她衝回家。

看到她躺在床上，面對如此完美的小女孩，他無法控制自己，強姦了她。然而她竟然很享受！更糟糕的是，她的妹妹彼岸花前來尋找姊姊莉莉。不久後，他和兩姊妹都發生了關係！
